_readme: Fixed images. Service, commercial, region and town images are added automatically from their content files (keys service-<slug>, commercial-<slug>, region-<slug>, town-<slug>). To use a real photo, put <key>.jpg|png|webp in src/assets/photos/ and run npm run images. Each fixed image also carries its alt text here (read via imgAlt() in src/lib/site.ts); update it whenever the photo changes.
